    37	/--
    38	Given a cofiltered diagram `D` of quasi-compact `S`-schemes with affine transition maps,
    39	and another scheme `X` of finite type over `S`.
    40	Then the canonical map `colim Homₛ(Dᵢ, X) ⟶ Homₛ(lim Dᵢ, X)` is injective.
    41	
    42	In other words, for each pair of `a : Homₛ(Dᵢ, X)` and `b : Homₛ(Dⱼ, X)` that give rise to the
    43	same map `Homₛ(lim Dᵢ, X)`, there exists a `k` with `fᵢ : k ⟶ i` and `fⱼ : k ⟶ j` such that
    44	`D(fᵢ) ≫ a = D(fⱼ) ≫ b`.
    45	-/
    46	@[stacks 01ZC "Injective part of (1) => (3)"]
    47	lemma Scheme.exists_hom_hom_comp_eq_comp_of_locallyOfFiniteType
    48	    {i : I} (a : D.obj i ⟶ X) (ha : t.app i = a ≫ f)
    49	    {j : I} (b : D.obj j ⟶ X) (hb : t.app j = b ≫ f)
    50	    (hab : c.π.app i ≫ a = c.π.app j ≫ b) :
    51	    ∃ (k : I) (hik : k ⟶ i) (hjk : k ⟶ j),
    52	      D.map hik ≫ a = D.map hjk ≫ b := by
    53	  let o := IsCofiltered.min i j
    54	  obtain ⟨k, hik, heq⟩ := Scheme.exists_hom_comp_eq_comp_of_locallyOfFiniteType D t f c hc
    55	    (D.map (IsCofiltered.minToLeft i j) ≫ a) (D.map (IsCofiltered.minToRight i j) ≫ b)
    56	    (by simp [← ha])
    57	    (by simp [← hb]) (by simpa)
    58	  use k, hik ≫ IsCofiltered.minToLeft i j, hik ≫ IsCofiltered.minToRight i j
    59	  simpa using heq
    60	
    61	end LocallyOfFiniteType

    63	/-!
    64	### Sections of the limit
    65	
    66	Let `D` be a cofiltered diagram of schemes with affine transition maps.
    67	Consider the canonical map `colim Γ(Dᵢ, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(lim Dᵢ, ⊤)`.
    68	
    69	If `D` consists of quasicompact schemes, then this map is injective. More generally, we show
    70	that if `s t : Γ(Dᵢ, U)` have equal image in `lim Dᵢ`, then they are equal at some `Γ(Dⱼ, Dⱼᵢ⁻¹ U)`.
    71	See `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_app_map_eq_map_of_isLimit`.

    73	If `D` consists of qcqs schemes, then this map is surjective. Specifically, we show that
    74	any `s : Γ(lim Dᵢ, ⊤)` comes from `Γ(Dᵢ, ⊤)` for some `i`.
    75	See `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_appTop_π_eq_of_isLimit`.
    76	
    77	These two results imply that `PreservesLimit D Scheme.Γ.rightOp`, which is available as an instance.
    78	
    79	-/

   236	If `X` is locally of finite presentation over `S`, then any `S`-morphism `lim Dᵢ ⟶ X` factors

   239	lemma Scheme.exists_π_app_comp_eq_of_locallyOfFinitePresentation
   240	    [IsCofiltered I] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
   241	    [∀ {i j} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
   242	    [∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
   243	    (a : c.pt ⟶ X) (ha : c.π ≫ t = (Functor.const _).map (a ≫ f)) :
   244	    ∃ (i : I) (g : D.obj i ⟶ X), c.π.app i ≫ g = a ∧ g ≫ f = t.app i := by
   245	  classical
   246	  -- The open cover of `c := lim Dᵢ` indexed by triplets of affine opens `(U, V, W)` with
   247	  -- `U ⊆ c`, `V ⊆ X`, `W ⊆ S` such that `U` maps to `V` maps to `W`.
   248	  have 𝒰 := (c.pt.isBasis_affineOpens).isOpenCover_mem_and_le
   249	    (((X.isBasis_affineOpens).isOpenCover_mem_and_le
   250	    ((S.isBasis_affineOpens).isOpenCover.comap f.base.hom)).comap a.base.hom)
   251	  -- By qcqs, this cover descends to some finite affine open cover `𝒱` of `Dᵢ`.

   254	      ∀ j, D.map fi'i ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒱 j ≤ t.app i' ⁻¹ᵁ j.1.1.2.1.2.1 := by
   255	    choose k fk hk using fun j ↦ exists_map_preimage_le_map_preimage D c hc (h𝒱𝒰 j).1.isCompact
   256	      (V := t.app i ⁻¹ᵁ j.1.1.2.1.2.1) (by
   257	      rw [← Hom.comp_preimage, ← NatTrans.comp_app, ha]
   258	      exact (h𝒱𝒰 j).2.symm.trans_le (j.1.prop.2.trans (a.preimage_mono j.1.1.2.prop.2)))

   261	    rw [← hfi', Functor.map_comp, Hom.comp_preimage]

   263	    simp only [← Hom.comp_preimage, t.naturality, Functor.const_obj_obj,
